item.title: Henry Halfhead FLOPS With Just 44 Players as Sweet Baby Inc. Backlash Sparks Calls for Boycott
item.description: The independent game Henry Halfhead has found itself at the center of controversy, not because of its mechanics or genre, but due to its association with a polarizing consulting firm.
